record.title: Test a guarded stock XDMA mapping and capture its first register access
record.intent: Validate the smallest observable mapped-access boundary using pinned public reference ABI evidence.
requirements: Preserve the stock APK and native library byte-for-byte, including their executable instructions.
Keep public RE semantics, stock observations and modeled transport explicitly separate.
Limit the adapter to the exact stock bypass open and mmap; stop rather than supply unknown register behavior.
Do not access physical hardware, change host security, or globally disable guest security controls.
acceptance: Pin and compare Orange-Rigol source provenance, device ABI, mmap and DMA semantics against the stock consumer.
Document the selected boundary, alternatives, fidelity limits, and future replay or hardware backend path.
Validate fault capture with deterministic private read/write controls and an unrelated ordinary-memory control.
Repeat fresh guest attempts, record exact mapping requests and first unsupported access or reproducible negative.
Capture system_server stability, stock hashes, instrumentation limits and raw evidence without inventing hardware values.
